title: Change In Control: NFE Altamira FLNG, S. de R.L. de C.V.
snippet: The Hydrocarbons and Geothermal Energy Office of the Department of Energy (DOE) gives notice of receipt of a Statement of Change in Control (Statement) filed by NFE Altamira FLNG, S. de R.L. de C.V. (NFE Altamira) on June 4, 2026. The Statement describes an anticipated change in NFE Altamira's upstream ownership.
